# LuaSPortFrame:value

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the value of the frame.

```lua
local value = frame:value([value])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns
